cancellation_requests_decision_check.name: cancellation_requests_decision_check
cancellation_requests_decision_check.value: ("cancellation_requests"."status" = 'pending_decision' AND "cancellation_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) OR ("cancellation_requests"."status" <> 'pending_decision' AND "cancellation_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

refunds_origin_reference_check.name: refunds_origin_reference_check
refunds_origin_reference_check.value: ("refunds"."origin" = 'cancellation' AND "refunds"."cancellation_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."claim_id" IS NULL) OR ("refunds"."origin" = 'claim' AND "refunds"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."cancellation_request_id" IS NULL) OR ("refunds"."origin" = 'insufficient_stock' AND "refunds"."claim_id" IS NULL AND "refunds"."cancellation_request_id" IS NULL)
